definition_title: Affine-partition sampler and independent column hashing
natural_language_statement:
For each layer $i$ and field element $a$, independently choose the coefficient vectors of two uniform linear forms $\mu_{i,a},\nu_{i,a}:F^d\to F$. Put $\lambda_i(z)=\sum_{j=0}^{d-1}\alpha_i^jz_j$. The preliminary column indexed by $(i,a,u,v)$ has value one at $z$ exactly when
$$\lambda_i(z)=a,\qquad\mu_{i,a}(z)=u,\qquad\nu_{i,a}(z)=v.$$
Independently choose each function $h_i:F^3\to\{0,\ldots,b-1\}$ uniformly from all functions. In row $z$ the final matrix has a one in position $ib+h_i(\lambda_i(z),\mu_{i,\lambda_i(z)}(z),\nu_{i,\lambda_i(z)}(z))$ for each layer $i$; all other columns, including the padding up to $n$, are zero. This is the binary column sum of equation (4), since each row had just one neighbor in each layer.

The sampler law is the pushforward of the uniform law on the complete product of coefficient vectors and hash tables. It is unconditioned. The preliminary-good event requires $|\Gamma_A(S)|\ge(k-d+1)|S|$ simultaneously for all $|S|\le n^{1-\varepsilon}$.

**Formalization Note** The tables include every level set and every hash argument, so product uniformity gives precisely the independence stipulated in the source. No full-rank requirement is imposed on random forms. Outside the eventual range $kb\le n$, the matrix formula simply drops out-of-range column positions; theorems make no correctness claim about those sizes.
definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_Parameters
set_option autoImplicit false
open scoped Classical

namespace ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch

open scoped BigOperators
abbrev Forms (F : Type*) (d k : ℕ) := Fin 2 → Fin k → F → Fin d → F
abbrev Hashes (F : Type*) (k b : ℕ) := Fin k → (F × F × F) → Fin b
noncomputable instance bucketNonempty (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (Fin (buckets ε n)) :=
  ⟨⟨0, by unfold buckets; exact pow_pos (by decide) _⟩⟩
noncomputable def fixedForm {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n) (i : Fin k) (z : Fin d → g.F) : g.F :=
  ∑ j, alpha g i ^ j.val * z j
noncomputable def linearForm {F : Type*} [Field F] {d : ℕ} (a z : Fin d → F) : F :=
  ∑ j, a j * z j
noncomputable def address {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n) (s : Forms g.F d k)
    (i : Fin k) (z : Fin d → g.F) : g.F × g.F × g.F :=
  let a := fixedForm g i z
  (a, linearForm (s 0 i a) z, linearForm (s 1 i a) z)
noncomputable def preliminary {d n k : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n) (s : Forms g.F d k) :
    Matrix (Fin (rowCount d n)) (Fin k × (g.F × g.F × g.F)) Bit := by
  classical
  exact fun z c => if address g s c.1 (g.rowOrder z) = c.2 then 1 else 0
noncomputable def combined {d n k b : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n) (s : Forms g.F d k)
    (h : Hashes g.F k b) : Generator (rowCount d n) n := by
  classical
  exact fun z j => if ∃ i : Fin k, ∃ u : Fin b,
    j.val = i.val * b + u.val ∧ h i (address g s i (g.rowOrder z)) = u then 1 else 0
noncomputable def sampleLaw (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n) :
    PMF (Generator (rowCount (dimension ε) n) n) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype _ : PMF (Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε) ×
    Hashes g.F (arity ε) (buckets ε n))).map fun s => combined g s.1 s.2
noncomputable def PreliminaryGood (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n)
    (s : Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε)) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Finset (Fin (rowCount (dimension ε) n)),
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε) →
    ((arity ε : ℝ) - dimension ε + 1) * S.card ≤ ((neighbors (preliminary g s) S).card : ℝ)

end ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch
source: Isaac M Hair, Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch, STOC 2027 submission #824 (October 2026), printed p. 8 / PDF p. 9, §2.1, equations (3)–(4); printed p. 9 / PDF p. 10, sampling law and padding.
